title: Improve quantized kernels: INT8/FP8 smoothquant + dequant-fusion; scheduler & KV-cache alignment
author: Anika Patel
description:
Motivation: Production quantized inference (INT8/FP8) is a major cost lever for our customers. Current kernels handle quant/dequant as separate passes which increases memory traffic and limits kernel fusion opportunities. This PR introduces fused dequant paths, SmoothQuant-aware scaling in kernels, and scheduler + KV-cache alignment changes to reduce cache-miss induced stalls for quantized workloads.

Summary of changes: consolidated and optimized INT8 and FP8 paths to allow (1) in-kernel SmoothQuant scaling, (2) dequant + GEMM fusion when the downstream operator expects FP16/FP32, and (3) aligned KV-cache storage/access for quantized attention rows to avoid per-request re-quantization and reduce memory bandwidth. The scheduler now prefers quant-fusion-compatible kernels when model and hardware support are detected; fallback to existing paths if not. Continuous batching logic was extended to preserve quantization alignment across batched requests and to avoid splitting batches in ways that would force dequant roundtrips.

Checklist: - [x] Kernel implementation and unit tests for INT8/FP8 fused paths - [x] SmoothQuant scaling integration and tests - [x] KV-cache layout changes + migration tests - [x] Scheduler heuristics + feature-flag guarded rollout - [x] Microbenchmarks and perf regression checks - [x] Documentation updates (runtime/kernels.md) - [x] End-to-end validation against host models and existing regression prompts

Compatibility and safety: Changes are behind the runtime flag runtime.quant_fusion.enabled (default: off in main until rollout). Fallback paths maintained; when the flag is off or model/hardware incompatible, system uses previous kernels. Migration of KV cache layout is guarded: on startup the node will check persisted cache version and transparently migrate on first write.

Testing and verification: Unit tests cover arithmetic correctness vs dequant+gemm baseline, and new property tests validate value ranges under SmoothQuant scaling. Integration tests run a small GPT-like model with mixed INT8/FP8 weights and verify parity within tolerance on logits and highest-prob tokens. Performance tests are included below.

Rollout plan: merge to main behind feature flag, dogfood on internal Dedicated cluster for 1 week, ramp to 25% of hosted inference traffic for quant-compatible models, monitor token-level quality metrics and perf dashboards. If regressions seen, revert flag or restrict to specific model families.

release_notes:
- Add fused dequant+GEMM kernels for INT8/FP8 to reduce memory traffic and improve throughput.
- Introduce SmoothQuant-aware scaling in kernels to maintain output quality for mixed-precision models.
- Scheduler heuristics to prefer quant-fusion compatible kernels when supported.
- KV-cache layout changes to store quant-aligned attention rows and avoid re-quantization on hot paths.
- All changes behind runtime.quant_fusion.enabled feature flag; rollout planned and monitored.
